jobs.description:
Since 1854, Katoen Natie has grown from a Belgian family business into a global logistics powerhouse with operations spanning five continents. Based in the strategic Gent Port, we specialize in warehousing, transport, cargo handling, and supply chain solutions for international clients. Our success stems from combining 170  years of expertise with innovative technology and a personal, SME approach to business.Join our dynamic team where tradition meets innovation, and every day brings new challenges in the exciting world of international logistics.

Jobomschrijving

THE OPPORTUNITYWe're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standardsOperational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processesHands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when neededPerformance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiativesCritical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situationsSafety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all timesReporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational managementContinuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:Essential Requirements:

3  years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environmentsForklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlinesPhysical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feetFlexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekendsProblem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experienceExperience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)Knowledge of customs procedures and international shippingLean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experienceMultilingual capabilities for our international client base

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst – Industrial IoT & Predictive Maintenance
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.

• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.
